latestVersion.changelog:
MapV-Three 1.0.3 — Major update with new documentation and expanded feature coverage:

- Completely restructured and greatly expanded documentation with detailed guides for various components (3D tiles, heatmap, materials, data sources, events, etc.).
- Added reference guides for data management, visualization primitives, trackers, editors, measurement, 3D model handling, special effects, weather/sky, heatmap, terrain/imagery/vector tiles, and core engine usage.
- Removed outdated PlaceSearch/RoutePlan/PlaceDetail references—focus shifts from Baidu Map UI to MapV-Three’s 3D GIS capabilities.
- Clarified coordinate systems, event binding modes, engine init patterns, and property assignment conventions in new best practices docs.
- Updated skill metadata and README to reflect MapV-Three’s expanded scope and features.
